1.web: The burden of the valley of vision. What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops?
1.asv: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?

2.web: You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town; your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.
2.asv: O thou that art full of shoutings, a tumultuous city, a joyous town; thy slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.

3.web: All your rulers fled away together. They were bound by the archers. All who were found by you were bound together. They fled far away.
3.asv: All thy rulers fled away together, they were bound by the archers; all that were found of thee were bound together; they fled afar off.

4.web: Therefore I said, “Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don’t labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
4.asv: Therefore said I, Look away from me, I will weep bitterly; labor not to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

5.web: For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity, from the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, in the valley of vision; a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.”
5.asv: For it is a day of discomfiture, and of treading down, and of perplexity, from the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, in the valley of vision; a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.

6.web: Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.
6.asv: And Elam bare the quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.

7.web: Your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.
7.asv: And it came to pass, that thy choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.

8.web: He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.
8.asv: And he took away the covering of Judah; and thou didst look in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.

9.web: You saw the breaches of the city of David, that they were many; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
9.asv: And ye saw the breaches of the city of David, that they were many; and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool;

10.web: You numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.
10.asv: and ye numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and ye brake down the houses to fortify the wall;

11.web: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who purposed it long ago.
11.asv: ye made also a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But ye looked not unto him that had done this, neither had ye respect unto him that purposed it long ago.

12.web: In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth:
12.asv: And in that day did the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:

13.web: and behold, joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating flesh and drinking wine: “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die.”
13.asv: and, behold, joy and gladness, slaying oxen and killing sheep, eating flesh and drinking wine: Let us eat and drink, for to-morrow we shall die.

14.web: Yahweh of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.
14.asv: And Jehovah of hosts revealed himself in mine ears, Surely this iniquity shall not be forgiven you till ye die, saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.

15.web: Thus says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, “Go, get yourself to this treasurer, even to Shebna, who is over the house, and say,
15.asv: Thus saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, who is over the house, and say,

16.web: ‘What are you doing here? Who has you here, that you have dug out a tomb here?’ Cutting himself out a tomb on high, chiseling a habitation for himself in the rock!”
16.asv: What doest thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out here a sepulchre? hewing him out a sepulchre on high, graving a habitation for himself in the rock!

17.web: Behold, Yahweh will overcome you and hurl you away violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.
17.asv: Behold, Jehovah, like a strong man, will hurl thee away violently; yea, he will wrap thee up closely.

18.web: He will surely wind you around and around, and throw you like a ball into a large country. There you will die, and there the chariots of your glory will be, you shame of your lord’s house.
18.asv: He will surely wind thee round and round, and toss thee like a ball into a large country; there shalt thou die, and there shall be the chariots of thy glory, thou shame of thy lord’s house.

19.web: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.
19.asv: And I will thrust thee from thine office; and from thy station shalt thou be pulled down.

20.web: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,
20.asv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:

21.web: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
21.asv: and I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand; and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

22.web: I will lay the key of the house of David on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.
22.asv: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; and he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.

23.web: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.
23.asv: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.

24.web: They will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the pitchers.
24.asv: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the flagons.

25.web: “In that day,” says Yahweh of Armies, “the nail that was fastened in a sure place will give way. It will be cut down, and fall. The burden that was on it will be cut off, for Yahweh has spoken it.”
25.asv: In that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, shall the nail that was fastened in a sure place give way; and it shall be hewn down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off; for Jehovah hath spoken it.
